comment: Default change-gate policy: what a proposed harness change must NOT hurt (guards) and what it MUST improve somewhere (improvements). Values are judged per paired cell (same task, same model, baseline vs candidate). Deployment-local: tighten/loosen tolerances or add registry metric ids for your team's bar; the gate stage refuses unknown ids loudly. 'source': 'referee' is the independent re-score (direction comes from the task); 'source': 'bench' reads the metric registry (direction declared here). on_missing: 'fail' makes an unevaluable guard fail the gate (use for the score — a candidate that lost its referee evidence must not pass); 'skip' reports it as not evaluable. Tolerances are how much WORSE the candidate may be before the guard trips; min_gain is how much BETTER it must be to count as the demonstrated improvement.
comment_missing_cell: A candidate that no longer fields a run on a (task, model) cell the baseline covers has silently dropped coverage — that fails the gate unless set to 'skip'.
